summary: P1: scripts/benchmark (Go, module-internal) builds all fixtures and the CLI binary under temp dirs, validates the exact 1,873,500-token baseline across exactly five sources with per-source totals, asserts five delta cases (valid Devin/OpenCode appends, rewrite, truncate, delete), resets every thermal snapshot (not just Devin) while preserving pricing, isolates HOME plus every tool-root override and XDG path, and stops with a nonzero exit on fixture mismatch, subprocess failure, malformed NDJSON, early stream exit, or a source change that is never reflected. P2: the runner records 30 cold / 100 warm / 20 large-fixture monotonic samples with p50/p95, sustained 60s live-monitor runs at 100ms and 1s with CPU seconds/wall seconds, refresh lines, change events, NDJSON validity, source freshness, and SIGINT cancellation, plus per-machine verdicts; docs/PERFORMANCE.md publishes the raw samples, methods, verdicts, allocation separation, and a disclosed scale gap.

cases.evidence: TestValidateTotalsExactAndPerturbed rejects off-by-one per-source perturbations, unexpected extra sources, missing sources, and grand-total mismatches while accepting the exact baseline. TestRunThermalTotalsSubprocessHandling rejects nonzero exits and malformed output via a stub binary. `go test ./scripts/benchmark ./internal/loaders` exits 0. Exact baseline/delta checks passed in the live run (5/5 mutations exact).

Cold reset clears devin/, codex/, zed/ and other artifacts (TestResetThermalSnapshotsKeepsPricingCatalog); cold count 0 -> warm count >0 asserted during the run; fixture homes only, never user caches; no binary lands in the repo root (built under temp). `./scripts/benchmark.sh --out /tmp/thermal-bench-final` exited 0 after all correctness checks.

Run at revision e2cdc72 (diff sha256 6000d420...) recorded raw cold/warm/large/Warm samples, stream measurements and verdicts in bench-report.json; docs/PERFORMANCE.md embeds the same samples, exact commands, fixture dimensions, and separate warm-latency/freshness/CPU verdicts with sample sizes. All evidence synthetic; TTY responsiveness explicitly not measured (NDJSON is not TTY evidence).

env -u NO_COLOR go test -race ./... exit 0 (including scripts/benchmark); go vet ./... exit 0; go build exit 0; gate 107/107 exit 0. No gate can PASS on bad fixture totals (runner exits nonzero) or a dead live process (early stream exit and unreflected appends fail with nonzero exit; covered by helper validation tests and rejection paths). A missed performance target (large-fixture warm p50 42.4ms) is disclosed as a scale gap, not a fake PASS.
